name: PrelaunchUAE
source: Founder decision, 15 Nov 2026: redesign in prelaunch.ae's colour scheme (black + gold, dark-first). Replaces Brand Guidelines v1.0 colours (Midnight Ink #0B1F33, Launch Amber #E07A2E, Desert Sand #F4EFE6).

decisions.decision: Use prelaunch.ae's black + gold scheme across the whole site, articles included.
PrelaunchUAE logo files recoloured to match (shapes unchanged): reversed letters cream #F2EDE3, tallest tower and spark gold #C9A84C, subline #9E9488; app icon and favicon on a #0A0A0A tile.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: html and body background; color-scheme dark.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover, form field fill, select panel.

tokens.name: warm
tokens.usage: Moment bands only (register, golden visa); gradient #0d0b09 > #1a1508 > #0d0b09.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Body text. 12.9:1 on page, 11.8:1 on surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, labels. AA on every dark ground (5.6 to 6.6:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Accent, filled buttons, highlighted word, icons, small gold text (8.7:1 on page).

tokens.name: gold-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of gold; focus ring (3:1+ on every dark ground).

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Gradient stops and pressed states only.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on gold. Never white on gold (2.3:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card edges (gold 14% on black).

tokens.name: input-line
tokens.usage: Form field edges: 3.3:1 on the field fill (surface-2 #1E1E1E), 3.5:1 on cards (WCAG 1.4.11).

display.use: Headlines and figures, 600 to 800, tight tracking

text.use: Body 16/1.6, forms, buttons (700 13px caps, .12em), prices, tables

shape.radius: 0 for buttons, cards, inputs, pills; 2px for frames. Round only for dots, step circles, avatars.

logo.rule: Keep x (one tower width) clear on every side. Never stretch, rotate, add effects or rearrange. Use the reversed files on black; never put the full-colour logo on gold.
